articles.title: North Korean hackers are moving tens of millions on Hyperliquid as Trump pushes to onshore the crypto platform
articles.snippet: Blockchain data reviewed by CoinDesk shows wallets tied to North Korea’s Lazarus Group sold more than $30 million in bitcoin on the platform in the last three weeks alone.

articles.title: Robinhood Chain beats Ethereum in daily revenue as memecoin trading takes over
articles.snippet: The two-month-old network processed a record 5.52 million transactions on Aug. 30 as users launched 22,600 tokens and memecoin trading tools drove most of the $2.66 million in revenue.

articles.title: Bitcoin barely blinks as U.S. hits Iran, sending oil higher and stocks lower
articles.snippet: BTC remains August's best-performing asset after the latest escalation in geopolitical tensions.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s new quantum defenses, 18.9M SOL cancelled: Hodler’s Digest
articles.snippet: Bitcoin moves toward a post quantum future, Solana validators agree to curb rampant inflation and the bull case from Bernstein is for Bitcoin to peak at $500K this cycle.

articles.title: Trump-promoted brand touts GOLD before token collapse
articles.snippet: Real Trump Coins promoted GOLD before deleting related X posts, while team-linked wallets sold 224.5 million tokens as its market value fell about 99%.
